title: Potatoism Historical Symbol Strata — 2026
purpose: Preserve dated and approximately dated formulations that materially shaped Potatoism without allowing early wording, remembered wording or unresolved vocabulary to overwrite mature canonical definitions.
canonical_boundary: Current identities remain owned by data/potatoism-concept-registry.json and mature formal interpretation by knowledge/philosophy/timic-dynamics.json / knowledge/philosophy/potato-philosophy.json. This record owns development, contradiction, earlier variants and unresolved source targets.
source_policy: Exact recovered conversation wording may be preserved as conversation-primary when independently locatable. Memory summaries and remembered compact phrases remain conversation archaeology until their originating message, post, recording or artifact is recovered.

formulations: Potatoes are ascending angels moving from earth toward heaven.
The work begins inward and then moves outward.
Mud is what is cleared or metabolized on the path.
The compressed commandments are: be simple; grow to light.
strata.boundary: Project-spiritual language, not biological or empirical angelology.

strata.formulation: Wedges carved from the Whole Whole.
strata.meaning_at_time: Local perspectives or identities were imagined as partial cuts through a larger totality.
strata.later_development: Relationship-first ontology, projection/cross-section models and typed Source/House/Axis relations replace the earlier undifferentiated totality language.
Mature ethics reframes the insight as protecting relation, growth, autonomy and generative capacity.

strata.formulation: Right and Wrong are not opposites — they are vectors. Right climbs; Wrong descends; both belong to a whole.
strata.later_development: Life/Strife dynamics retains directional consequence while dropping any simplistic equation of literal ascent/descent with moral value.
strata.ethical_boundary: Belonging to one whole does not erase accountability or make harmful and beneficial actions equivalent.

strata.formulation: Potato operates across food, seed, body, wedge, Door, center and chariot/messenger roles.
strata.later_development: The mature Potato Operator narrows this into compression → Door → differentiated re-expression.
strata.boundary: Cross-domain portability is symbolic methodology, not scientific equivalence.

strata.formulation: The viewer always sees a bigger Potato, but the Swamp sees only a plane.
strata.boundary: Representation metaphor unless a separate scientific dimensional model is defined and tested.

formulations: The Son opens the Door. The Father walks the Garden beyond it.
Son-side language emphasizes embodiment, ordeal, death/return and threshold; Father-side language increasingly emphasizes duration, Garden, cultivation and Heaven after the Door.
strata.comparative_boundary: This project framing must not be used as a total definition of Christianity.

formulations: Red grows from self; Blue grows from comparison with.
Red does not require Blue's opinion in order to create.
Blue is associated in this stratum with memory, meticulousness, fear and strife.
Red is associated in this stratum with creativity, love, light and life.
strata.development: Later doctrine makes Blue a useful preservation/memory function rather than defining it wholly by fear/strife.

formulations: Blue remembers.
Red creates.
Son experiences.
strata.development: Direct precursor to the mature past/future/present-control model in Timic Dynamics.

formulations: Mud is compromat.
Mud is linked in this symbolic cluster with sin/Fall/entanglement/smear/forbidden fruit/stones or rocks.
Mud remains below the Door.
strata.development: Later Swamp/Farm models broaden unresolved residue from personal-symbolic material into attention and institutional ecologies.
strata.boundary: Symbolic equivalences are not labels for real people, crimes or legal evidence.

formulations: House sits at the center between Red and Blue.
Father's House is symbolically mapped to the thalamus.
Thalamic nuclei later become rooms in the House.
Father/Tim is imagined at an upper axial/throne position related symbolically to 33 vertebrae and North of North.
strata.boundary: Anatomical correspondences are symbolic mappings, not proof of theology.

formulations: Son is Door.
Pineal is used as symbolic Door/single-eye pole.
Son is the present experiential interface; the experience is described as vibe.
The Son cluster includes Lion and Jesus-Christ symbolic roles.
strata.boundary: The pineal correspondence is symbolic/phenomenological, not established neurotheology.

formulations: God doesn't fight. He gardens.
Compression test → compassion flow.
strata.development: Compressed precursors to Warrior-to-Gardener, generative-radius and wound-to-infrastructure ethics.
strata.ethical_boundary: Compassion does not require denial of harm or removal of boundaries.

formulations: An earlier visual mapping used Red toward earth/embodiment/blood/soil.
The corresponding Blue side was associated with heaven/spirit/water/sky.
strata.handling: Do not harmonize this away. Recover the original image/prompt and date it before drawing stronger conclusions.

unresolved_early_vocabulary.remembered_role: Earlier encompassing mind/soul or shared-field language before Source/Whole/House relations became more precise.
unresolved_early_vocabulary.handling: Recover exact context; determine whether comparative, literal or exploratory.

unresolved_early_vocabulary.remembered_role: Older coined political/psychological or shadow-order term.
unresolved_early_vocabulary.handling: Do not infer definition from etymology alone; recover source first.

unresolved_early_vocabulary.remembered_role: Staged-collapse motif from an earlier cosmology/history model.
unresolved_early_vocabulary.handling: Keep separate from later prophecy or political-collapse claims until chronology is recovered.

unresolved_early_vocabulary.remembered_role: Earlier image of conflict, flattening or loss of vitality before Tree of Strife / Swamp language stabilized.
unresolved_early_vocabulary.handling: Historical creative/metaphysical language, not factual diagnosis of society.

unresolved_early_vocabulary.remembered_role: Emphatic totality term from which wedges/perspectives were imagined as partial cuts.
unresolved_early_vocabulary.handling: Historical philosophical vocabulary; mature owners now use typed relations.

additional_recovery_targets: All Potatoes are body, but not all bodies are potatoes.
Potatoism doesn't seek order — it spits the pieces out so each may find their place naturally.
Every being is unique; realities/timelines may overlap while experience remains relative to the participant.
developmental_insights: Red/Blue develops from sharper value-coded polarity into balanced memory/creation functions.
Son develops from title/person-role into threshold/present-interface function.
House develops from dwelling image into integrating container of differentiated rooms/signals.
Mud develops from moral/compromising imagery into a wider unresolved-residue systems concept.
Older totality language becomes more precise as the archive differentiates Source, House, Door, Axis, Plane, observer and relation.
